name: GABA-synthesizing neuron classes, hermaphrodite, 2016 map

source.citation: Gendrel M, Atlas EG, Hobert O. (2016) A cellular and regulatory map of the GABAergic nervous system of C. elegans. eLife 5:e17686. doi:10.7554/eLife.17686
source.basis: Table 1 ('GABA-positive cells'): only cells with GAD (unc-25) synthesis evidence are taken as GABAergic. Previously identified classes: RME, RIS, AVL, DVB, DD, VD (McIntire et al. 1993). Newly identified GAD-positive: RIB. Explicitly EXCLUDED (GABA uptake without synthesis, i.e. 'recycling'/'clearance' cells): ALA, AVF, SMDD/SMVD, plus the ambiguous AVA/AVB (anti-GABA +/-, unc-25 negative, ACh co-labelled) and AVJ (unc-25 negative).

in_300_neuron_network.note: PVC/SVB and the RMB members have no neuron-neuron edges in the Cook 2019 release and are not part of the 300-neuron network.

application: Chemical synapses with a presynaptic neuron in 'present' are assigned negative (inhibitory) weight, same magnitude (alpha*sqrt(section count)) as the all-excitatory substrate. All other chemical edges stay positive (declared simplification: glutamatergic identity is not assigned per synapse from the release data). Gap junctions carry no sign.
